slide_1.first_textbox: Readiness reviews align platform, support, and product teams before high-impact releases.
slide_1.first_bullet: Verify monitoring thresholds and alert ownership for each critical service.
slide_1.second_bullet: Confirm escalation routes, backup responders, and weekend support coverage.
slide_1.third_bullet: Check rollback rehearsals and communications for customer-facing incidents.
slide_1.second_textbox: A structured review keeps launch risk manageable under time pressure.
